source_artifact.source_agent: Finding Hidden Customers Agent v0.5 Beta

gap.what_is_missing: Deterministic Stage-3 decline on Standard 7 (type-span). The segment's specific_facts are two entries both of fact_type 'name' (Triangle Equipment, Wolter), so the specifics span a single fact_type; Standard 7 requires at least two fact_type values with at least one name/location/event. The exemplar cannot be built. Beyond the mechanical failure, the segment also lacks telling material: its only public specifics and its EDP are the buyer's own completed acquisitions (a finding signal), which under the ruling 'the EDP finds, it does not tell' cannot seed Standard 6 information asymmetry (the buyer knows its own deals) and yields no directive-lens insight for Standard 4. Members were stamped (Tuckahoe Holdings, Wolter) and satisfy entailment, but membership does not supply additional fact_types for Standard 7.
gap.input_that_would_close_it: FHC must source telling data for this segment: public cross-entity synthesis the roll-up buyer does not already know (analogous to the Gold segment's corridor demand synthesis), sourced from a database different from the acquisition finding signal, plus specific_facts that span at least two fact_type values (for example a dated integration-window figure or a dollar amount alongside the named acquirers). The acquisition announcement remains the finding signal only.
